title: 🛫 New activities in MSFS2020 Marketplace|Weekly Update|Master Your Flight Skills!|Week 42✈️
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 This week, most packages are focused on summer 2025 route updates. Several of these have been added for specific airliners and airports. For those who enjoy cargo missions, there's also a package in the Simple Aircargo II Missions bundle, featuring 10 package delivery missions. 🌟

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new enhanced scenery and enhanced airports or new aircrafts and liveries review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:

- New enhanced scenery and airports: https://youtu.be/30tQWR0zg6k
